info.title: Slath API
info.description: The Slath REST API. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <personal access token>`. Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents. Mutating requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header.

get.summary: Your notifications, newest first; things you can no longer read are left out.

patch.summary: Marks a notification read or unread.

get.summary: Organizations the authenticated user belongs to.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Creates an organization; the caller becomes its owner (`user:write`).

get.summary: An organization's profile (public).
An organization's members (members only).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

get.summary: One member's role (members only).

put.summary: Adds a member or changes their role (owners, `user:write`).

delete.summary: Removes a member, or leaves (`user:write`). The last owner can't leave.

get.summary: Repositories the caller can see (public ones for anonymous callers).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Creates a repository (`repo:write`).

Creates a repository and imports branches and tags into it in the
background (`repo:write`). Poll the import's report for the result.

get.summary: A repository.

delete.summary:
Deletes a repository (admins, `repo:write`). It disappears at once and
can be restored by a site administrator for a few days.

post.summary: Uploads a file (multipart field `file`) for use in issue and comment text.

get.summary: A file's content at a ref (up to the instance's render limit).

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path inside the repository (default: the root).

get.summary: Branches, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

get.summary: A repository's collaborators (admins).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

put.summary: Adds a collaborator or changes their role (admins).

get.summary: History of a ref, optionally limited to a path.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit ID (default: the default branch).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

get.summary: A commit with the files it changes (compared with its first parent).
The latest status of each context on a commit.
Whether a repository is a fork, of what, and whether copying finished.

post.summary:
Forks a repository into a namespace of yours (`repo:write`). Copying
runs in the background; poll the fork's `/fork` until it's `done`.

get.summary:
The import report of a repository (administrators of it; 404 if it
wasn't imported).
A repository's issues, newest first.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated label names; issues must have all of them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Opens an issue.

delete.summary: Deletes a comment (own, or any for maintainers).

get.summary: One issue.

patch.summary: Edits an issue, or closes or reopens it (author or triage).

get.summary: An issue's comments, oldest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Adds a comment.

get.summary: A repository's labels.

post.summary: Creates a label (maintainers).

delete.summary: Deletes a label and removes it from all issues (maintainers).

get.summary: A repository's merge requests, newest first.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: Comma-separated label names; merge requests must have all of them.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Opens a merge request from a branch of this repository.

get.summary: One merge request.

patch.summary:
Edits, closes or reopens, or marks a merge request draft or ready
(author or triage).

get.summary: The conversation's comments, oldest first.

post.summary: Comments on a merge request.

get.summary: Every identity decision and effect on review state, oldest first.

post.summary:
Merges the merge request (`mr.merge`). 409 when its head isn't
`expected_head_oid`, a requirement isn't met, merging conflicts, or the
target kept moving.

get.summary: Whether the merge request can be merged, with each requirement.

put.summary: Sets who is asked to review (the author or triagers).

get.summary: The reviews of a merge request, oldest first.

post.summary:
Reviews the current revision. The author may only comment; a comment
needs a body.

get.summary:
The changes of the current revision: each commit with its change ID
and how it was matched.

post.summary:
Binds a commit of the current revision by hand: picks a change for an
unresolved commit, splits a continued change into a new one
(`change: null`), or joins a new change to a removed one. Open to the
author and anyone who can push the source; audited.

get.summary:
The threads the caller may see, with their position in the current
revision.

post.summary:
Starts a thread on lines of a revision's diff, or on the whole merge
request.

patch.summary:
Resolves or reopens a thread (the merge request's author, the thread's
author, or someone who can push).

post.summary: Answers in a thread.

get.summary: A repository's milestones, open ones first.

post.summary: Creates a milestone (maintainers).

delete.summary: Deletes a milestone; its issues keep existing without one (maintainers).

patch.summary: Changes, closes, or reopens a milestone (maintainers).

get.summary: A repository's branch protection rules (admins).

post.summary: Creates the rule for a pattern, or replaces it (admins).

get.summary:
Suggestions for completing a reference in this repository's text: at
most 10, ranked. Never includes email addresses; 60 requests a minute.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: What was typed so far (with or without the leading `@`, `#`, `~`, `%`).

parameters.name: item
parameters.description: The issue being edited (its participants rank first).

post.summary:
Reports a status on a commit (scope `statuses:write`). The latest
status per context wins.

Brings a fork's branch up to its parent's (`repo:write`): a
fast-forward, or with `discard` a force update. Branch protection of the
fork applies.

get.summary: Tags, newest first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

get.summary: The entries of a directory at a ref.

parameters.name: ref
parameters.description: Branch, tag, or commit ID (percent-encode slashes)

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path inside the repository (default: the root).

get.summary: Issues (titles, descriptions, and comments) you can read, best match first.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

get.summary: Repositories you can see whose name or description contains the query.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Part of a repository's name or description.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

get.summary: The authenticated user (`user:read`).
The user's SSH keys (`user:read`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Adds an SSH key (`user:write`).

delete.summary: Removes one of the user's SSH keys (`user:write`).

get.summary: The user's personal access tokens (never the secrets; `user:read`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (1 to the instance's maximum, default 30).

post.summary: Tokens can't be created through the API, only in the web UI in sudo mode.

delete.summary: Revokes one of the user's tokens (`user:write`).

get.summary: Server version and API generation.

content_type.description: The detected type: an image type, or `application/octet-stream`.

markdown.description: Markdown that embeds (images) or links (other files) the attachment.

url.description: Path of the file on this instance.

change.description: The change to continue (its ID), or null for a new change.

truncated.description: The change list was cut off at the instance's diff limits.

evidence.description:
Always `reported`: Slath knows who reported it, not that the check
ran.

reporter.description: Who reported it (a user or bot); `null` once that account is gone.

ahead.description:
Commits on the default branch that the parent's lacks, and the
other way round (when both have it and you can read the parent).

parent.description: `namespace/name` of the parent, if you can read it.

ImportReport.description: The state and result of an import.

secret_findings.description:
Possible secrets push protection found in the imported history; the
import isn't rejected for them.

body_html.description: The description rendered for the caller (references resolved).

body.description: Empty when deleted or hidden from the caller.

LedgerEntry.description: An entry of the review continuity ledger.

change_id.description: The change's ID in jj's format, where it's about one change.

detail.description:
Kind-specific facts (commit, the alias or patch that decided,
candidates, reviewer, status context, old and new heads).

MergeBody.description: Every field is optional in the JSON so that authorization runs first.

expected_head_oid.description: The head you reviewed; if the merge request moved on, 409.

description_html.description: The description rendered for the caller.

head_oid.description: Head commit of the current revision.

revisions.description: Number of revisions (pushes that changed the source).

MrReview.description: A review of a merge request.

counts.description:
The reviewer's current verdict (on this revision, or carried over a
rebase that kept every patch).

revision.description: The revision it was submitted on.

stale.description: An approval or request for changes made stale by later changes.

MrStack.description: The changes of a merge request's current revision.

entries.description: Empty when the revision can only be reviewed as a whole.

merge_blocked.description: An unresolved or conflicted commit blocks merging.

removed.description: Changes without a version in the current revision.

revision.description: The current revision; null before the first.

default_branch_only.description: Copy only the default branch (and its tags).

namespace.description: Required: your username or an organization you belong to.

visibility.description:
`public`, `internal`, or `private`; defaults to the parent's, and
can't be more visible than it.

password.description: Used once for the fetch and not stored.

url.description: An `https://` URL of a Git repository.

username.description: Used once for the fetch and not stored.

namespace.description: Your username or an organization you belong to.

NewStatus.description:
Every field is optional in the JSON so that authorization runs before
validation.

context.description: Up to 100 letters, digits, spaces, and `. _ / : -`.

commit.description: A version's commit, for a thread on one change's own diff.

path.description: Without a path, a thread on the whole merge request.

pending.description: Keep it in your pending review until you submit it.

state.description:
The issue's state (`open` or `closed`) or the merge request's
(`open`, `merged`, or `closed`).

PostProtection.description:
Every field is optional in the JSON so that authorization runs before
validation (a missing pattern is a 422 only for those allowed to ask).

status_reporters.description: Per context, user or bot names whose statuses count.

dismiss_approvals_on_new_revision.description: Any new revision makes earlier approvals stale, even a rebase.

dismiss_stale_approvals.description: New changes dismiss approvals (a rebase with identical patches doesn't).

pattern.description: Glob on the short branch name (`*` doesn't cross `/`).

require_up_to_date.description: The target must be an ancestor of the source.

required_approvals.description: Approvals by people with write access, other than the author.

required_status_contexts.description: Status contexts that must be `success` on the commit that lands.

status_reporters.description:
Per context, the users or bots whose statuses count (none listed:
anyone allowed, except the author and the author's bots).

statuses_on_head_ok.description: Statuses on the head also count for rebase and merge commits.

detail.description: Display name, issue state, or description.

value.description: The text to insert, e.g. `@alice`, `#12`, `~"needs review"`.

Requirement.description: One requirement of the merge box.

reviewers.description:
User names, and `org/team` for teams of the repository's
organization.

StackEntry.description: One commit of the current revision and the change it belongs to.

also_in.description: Other open merge requests of the repository with one of its IDs.

candidates.description: Changes it may continue (new) or must pick from (unresolved).

change_id.description: The change's ID in jj's format; null while unresolved.

conflicted.description: jj recorded a conflict in this commit.

earlier_versions.description: Versions of its change in earlier revisions.

position.description: 0 is the bottom of the stack.

branch.description:
Required: the fork's branch to bring up to the parent's branch of
the same name.

discard.description: If both have their own commits, drop the fork's (a force update).

revision.description: The revision it was made on, and its anchor there.

pending.description: Only its author sees it until their review is submitted.

ThreadPosition.description: Where a thread shows in the current revision.

from_revision.description: The revision it was made on, when it's carried from an earlier one.

prefix.description: The first characters after `slath_pat_`, for recognizing the token.

assignees.description: Replaces the assignees (usernames, at most 10; triage).

milestone.description: Milestone title; an empty string removes it (triage).

name.description: A new name; the old one keeps redirecting readers.
